queue.list.empty.title: The queue is empty
queue.list.empty.hint: Paste one or more links above and press Download: the queue takes it from there, two downloads at a time.
job.deno.title: Deno is required for YouTube extraction
job.deno.body: QuickJS could not solve the YouTube challenge. Deno is the automatic fallback (spec §5.3): install it once and downloads keep working.
job.whisper.title: Whisper sidecar is required for transcription
job.whisper.body: sdp-whisper is not installed. Install it to transcribe audio and video files locally (spec §5.4).
job.whisperModel.title: Whisper model is not installed
job.whisperModel.body: The selected Whisper model is not downloaded yet. Download it to transcribe this file.
settings.title: Settings
settings.outputDir.hint: Used when a new queue item does not pick a folder.
settings.downloads.parallel.hint: How many downloads at once (1 to 4). Two is the default: beyond that the network and the CPU struggle.
settings.downloads.perHost.hint: How many downloads at once from the same site. Two keeps you from looking like a bot.
settings.general.pasteAnywhere.hint: Paste links anywhere in the window, not only in the box. Opt-in.
settings.general.notifyIdle: Notify me when the queue finishes
settings.jsRuntime.hint: QuickJS ships with the app. Deno is downloaded only if QuickJS fails and you allow it; the choice is remembered for 24 hours or until yt-dlp changes.
settings.youtubeClients.hint: Leave empty: yt-dlp uses its own client list, kept current by its maintainers. The original app forced "web_embedded,web,tv"; that list is now an option here, not the default.
settings.cookies.hint: Some videos need your session (age, private, members-only). Reading the browser database can fail while the browser runs: then close it, or use a cookies file.
settings.accounts.comingSoon: Proxy, custom headers and impersonation arrive with M3.
tools.title: External tools
tools.table.caption: External tools used by the app, with their source, version and status
tools.choosePath.title: Choose the path to {tool}
tools.channel.title: yt-dlp updates
tools.channel.label: Channel
tools.channel.hint: An update only ever replaces the copy in the app data folder, never the one inside the installer.
tools.paths.title: Folders
tools.paths.hint: No secret is ever written here. It is here for diagnostics.
tools.wizard.title: Setup
tools.wizard.hint: Reopen the first-run steps: every one of them is optional.
tools.selfTest.title: YouTube extraction
tools.selfTest.hint: Runs one known public video through the inspection path and reports which JavaScript runtime answered and how long it took (spec §5.3.6).
tools.update.broken: yt-dlp was updated but no longer answers; restore the copy from the installer.
wizard.title: Setup
wizard.welcome.body: Scaricatore Di Porto uses yt-dlp to download and a small JavaScript interpreter for the sites that need one. Both are inside the app: there is nothing to install.
wizard.tools.body: {count} tool(s) ready. You can change any of this later, in Settings → Tools.
wizard.tools.bundled: yt-dlp and qjs ship with the app and work with no network at all.
wizard.tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg cannot be installed by the app yet: it arrives with the media-processing features.
wizard.tools.deno: Deno is not installed now: it is only needed if the JavaScript interpreter is not enough.
wizard.transcription.body: Offline transcription arrives later, with Whisper. This step can be skipped.
wizard.output.body: Downloads go to the system Downloads folder when it exists.
wizard.output.hint: You can change it any time in Settings → General.
toast.settingsRecovered: The settings file was unreadable: it was moved to {path} and the defaults are being used.
toast.queueIdle.title: Queue finished
toast.queueRetrying: Automatic retry {count}/2 after a network error.
toast.queueRecovered: The queue file was unreadable: it was kept as .bak and the queue starts empty.
toast.queueInterrupted: {count} items were running when the app closed: you can resume them.
toast.queueCleared: {count} finished items removed from the queue.
toast.hardwareEncoderFallback: Hardware encoder failed: finished with CPU encoder.
toast.whisperCpuFallback: Whisper GPU execution failed; completed using CPU (-ng).
toast.hallucinationWarning: Possible hallucination detected in transcript (repeated loops or silence).
error.ytdlp.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg is missing: merging video and audio, and the opus conversion, both need it
error.ytdlp.ytChallenge: YouTube refused the extraction (challenge). Try again, update yt-dlp, or use cookies
error.ytdlp.auth: This video needs your session: set cookies from the browser or a cookies file
error.ytdlp.unavailable: The video is not available (removed, private or blocked)
error.ytdlp.geo: Not available in your country: a proxy may help
error.ytdlp.format: That format is not available: choose another quality
error.ytdlp.unsupported: This link has no downloadable media. Updating yt-dlp may help
error.ytdlp.antibot: The site blocked the request (anti-bot). Retrying with browser impersonation may help (M3)
error.ytdlp.cookies: The browser cookies could not be read: close the browser, or use a cookies file
error.ytdlp.diskFull: No space left on the disk
error.ytdlp.network: Network problem: check the connection and retry
error.ytdlp.extract: yt-dlp could not read this page: updating it usually fixes this
error.ytdlp.denoMissing: Deno, the JavaScript fallback, is not installed

settings.archive.hint: Keep track of downloaded video IDs to avoid re-downloading them in playlists.
settings.files.includeId.hint: Appends [%(id)s] to the filename template to ensure uniqueness.
settings.files.limitRate.hint: Maximum download speed (e.g. 5M, 500K). Leave empty for unlimited.
settings.files.preferH264: Prefer H.264 video and AAC audio
settings.files.preferH264.hint: Sorts formats to favor widely compatible H.264/AAC over newer codecs (AV1/VP9).
settings.headers.hint: One Header: Value per line. Passed to yt-dlp via --add-headers.
settings.impersonate: Retry blocked requests with Chrome impersonation
settings.impersonate.hint: When a site responds with anti-bot or 403 Forbidden, retries once using --impersonate chrome.
settings.playlistUrl: Links with both video and playlist
settings.playlistUrl.hint: Default behaviour when a link has both watch?v=… and list=… parameters.
settings.proxy.hint: HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy URL (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080).

transcription.advanced.mirrorUrl.hint: Alternative base URL to download models from if Hugging Face is blocked or slow
